title: Chicken Enchiladas
description: Corn tortillas rolled around shredded chicken and cheese, smothered in a homemade red enchilada sauce and baked until bubbling.

image.alt: A baking dish of rolled enchiladas in red sauce with melted cheese and cilantro

items.note: about {qty 1 1/4 lb} raw, or a rotisserie chicken

steps.text: Make the sauce: heat the oil in the saucepan over medium heat, whisk in the flour and cook for {time 1 min}. Whisk in the chili powder, cumin, garlic powder, oregano and tomato paste for {time 30 sec}.
Slowly whisk in the broth, add the salt and simmer until slightly thickened, {time 8-10 min}. Heat the oven to {temp 375F oven}.
Mix the chicken with {qty 1/2 cup} of the sauce and half the cheese. Spread a thin layer of sauce in the baking dish.
Warm the tortillas briefly in the microwave, wrapped in a damp towel, so they roll without cracking. Fill each with chicken, roll up and set seam side down in the dish.
Pour the rest of the sauce over the top and sprinkle with the remaining cheese. Bake until bubbling and the cheese is melted, {time 20-25 min}.
Rest for {time 5 min}, then serve with sour cream and cilantro.

notes: Assemble up to a day ahead and refrigerate, covered; bake straight from the fridge, adding 10 minutes.
For quick cooked chicken, simmer breasts in salted water until they reach 165°F, about 15 minutes.
